# Writing your first program

0. Log onto a lab computer an open the program called IDLE
1. Click “File”, then “New File” in the menu that appears
2. In the new window that opened click “File” again, then “Save”
3. Use the save window to navigate to the “week1” folder inside the “csc106” folder that you created
4. Please type filename: IDLE_demo.py
5. Click “Save”

6. Inside the window, type the following text:
    ```print("Hello World!")```
7. From the menu, Run -> Run Module ... and that’s the first python program of the term!
